name: duotone-beat
title: Duotone Beat
description: A two-ink halftone portrait that swaps its ink pair on every beat, punches in on the downbeat and shows a bar indicator. A built-in silhouette stands in for the photo; a host replaces the contents of the .db-picture layer with its own image.
useWhen: A speaker, artist or team portrait should hit on the beat of a track, poster-style, for a promo or social cut.
The edit is cut to music at a known BPM and the visual should flash through brand color pairs in time.
A photo needs a bold two-color print treatment that keeps moving instead of sitting as a still.
avoidWhen: The print look should hold steady on a live scene with full color separation: use halftone-print.
The image should print once and settle, without a beat: use riso-print.
The beat should drive a camera jolt on heavy content rather than a color swap: use impact-shake.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Frames per beat
variables.description: Frames per beat at 30 fps (15 is 120 BPM).

variables.label: Beats per bar
variables.description: Beats per bar; the first beat of each bar gets the bigger punch-in.

variables.label: Punch
variables.description: Scale added on the downbeat. Off-beats get a third of it.

variables.label: Halftone pitch
variables.description: Halftone dot pitch in pixels at 720p. 0 keeps smooth tones.

variables.label: Bar indicator
variables.description: Show the beat squares and BPM tag.

variables.label: Ink pairs
variables.description: JSON list of [shadow ink, highlight ink] hex pairs, one per beat, cycled.
